findings.finding: Environment Agency documents persistent LIDAR Composite DTM 1m WCS endpoint, WCS 2.0.1, raw elevation pixels and NoData sentinel -3.4028235e+38.
Composite DTM 1m covers about 99% of England at 1m in EPSG:27700; 2022 composite survey period is 2000-06-06 through 2022-04-02 and survey index catalogues identify source survey by location.

Independent EA Ground Truth surveys use +/-3cm RMSE points and are used to verify time-stamped LIDAR survey RMSE, standard deviation and random error; this is QA evidence, not parcel-specific uncertainty.
OS Terrain50 ASCII grid is 10km by 10km, 200x200, 50m cells, values at pixel centres to 0.1m; tile metadata includes flying-date provenance.
OS Terrain50 full tiled supply is 2,858 10km tiles in 55 100km folders, no registration required, annual July resupply.
